briefings.title: Travelers deploys AI-powered claims countrywide with OpenAI

people.name: Erik Roen
people.role: Senior Vice President and CIO, Claim, Travelers

briefings.tldr: Travelers Insurance has partnered with OpenAI to deploy a countrywide, voice-based AI claim assistant for First Notice of Loss (FNOL), scaling from an eight-state pilot to a nationwide rollout in just two months while achieving an 80% to 90% completion rate among participating customers.
